Subject: Weekly MAP: legal/procurement action log & vendor setup blockers

Hi Kate / Blue Ridge team —

Quick weekly MAP update and a short ask on a couple of items blocking vendor activation. Summary below, then action owners.

1) MSA redlines
- We uploaded our suggested redlines (attached: Redwood_MSA-proposed-redlines.pdf). Key outstanding items we flagged: data residency carveouts, audit log retention SLA, and indemnity cap.
- Blue Ridge Legal: can you confirm whether you can accept the indemnity language we proposed (Section 9) or if you need alternative wording?

2) Order form & billing cadence
- Draft order form attached (OrderForm-BR-2027.xlsx). Pricing and seat counts are agreed; we still need final billing contact and PO number to complete procurement.

3) Vendor portal / marketplace setup
- AWS Marketplace listing is required for your procurement team to process the PO. We started the vendor setup but Amazon requested a DUNS verification and a company-level contact. We included the vendor_setup_checklist.xlsx.

Action items (owners):
- Blue Ridge Legal: confirm indemnity language OR provide counter wording (owner: Blue Ridge Legal) — target Thurs EOD 6/10
- Kate / Procurement: confirm billing contact and PO# (owner: Kate Miller) — target Mon 6/14
- Redwood Ops (Sean): escalate DUNS verification with AWS and push for vendor portal acceptance (owner: Sean Gallagher) — target Fri 6/11
- Redwood Sales (Monica): prepare fallback orderform with manual invoicing option if marketplace delays persist (owner: Monica Patel) — target Mon 6/14

Next sync: same time next week. If anything changes earlier, reply-all.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

Attachments: Redwood_MSA-proposed-redlines.pdf (PDF, 12 pages), OrderForm-BR-2027.xlsx (Excel), vendor_setup_checklist.xlsx (Excel)
